snippet.title: Downfall MMORPG - Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Downfall MMORPG is an open-world sci-fi & fantasy MMORPG where magic and technology collide. Choose a faction, forge your own playstyle, and fight for control of a living world in massive PvP battles and endless PvE adventures.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4291360/Downfall_MMORPG
